question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Somber
solution:
The correct answer is "**Cheerful**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Somber**: having or conveying a feeling of deep seriousness and sadness.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Boastful: **showing excessive pride and self-satisfaction in one's achievements, possessions, or abilities.
 
• **Mournful: **feeling, expressing, or inducing sadness, regret, or grief.
 
• **Doleful: **expressing sorrow; mournful.
 
• **Cheerful: **noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**cheerful**" is the antonym of "somber".
 
 
• **Example**: *The teacher's **cheerful **__attitude made learning a very enjoyable experience for the students.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Somber**: गहरी गंभीरता और उदासी की भावना होना या व्यक्त करना।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Boastful:**** **किसी की उपलब्धियों, संपत्ति या क्षमताओं में अत्यधिक गर्व और आत्म-संतुष्टि दिखाना।
 
• **Mournful:**** **उदासी, खेद, या दुःख को महसूस करना, व्यक्त करना या प्रेरित करना।
 
• **Doleful:**दुख व्यक्त करना; शोकाकुल।
 
• **Cheerful:**** **विशेष रूप से खुश और आशावादी।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**cheerful**" is the antonym of "somber".
